steps.label: Move Linear
steps.description: Move to a target in a straight line

fields.label: Target
fields.help: A saved point, a $points[i] element, a template naming a point, a grid or stack cell — or nothing for the current position (use with offsets).

fields.label: Speed
fields.help: Overrides the program's speed for this move only.

fields.label: Blend into next move
fields.help: Round the corner into the next move instead of stopping.

fields.label: Blend radius
fields.help: Empty = the radius set by Set Blend Radius.

fields.label: Offset
fields.help: Added to the target (relative move when there is no target).

fields.label: Override
fields.help: Replaces an axis of the target outright.

fields.label: Tool offset
fields.help: Applied in the tool frame at execution time.

fields.label: Local frame
fields.help: Run this move in a local frame instead of the active one.

fields.label: Stop condition
fields.help: Watched every tick while the move runs, e.g. $io.Nano.Load >= 2000.

fields.label: Position variable
fields.help: A Points list set to the one pose where the condition fired.

fields.label: Fired flag
fields.help: Set to 1 if the condition fired during the move, else 0.

steps.label: Move Arc
steps.description: Move along a circular arc through a via point to the end target

fields.label: Target
fields.help: A saved point, a $points[i] element, a template naming a point, a grid or stack cell — or nothing for the current position (use with offsets).

fields.label: Via point
fields.help: A point the arc passes through (saved point, $points[i] element or template).

fields.label: Speed
fields.help: Overrides the program's speed for this move only.

fields.label: Arc tolerance
fields.help: Largest allowed gap between the true arc and its straight segments.

fields.label: Offset
fields.help: Added to the target (relative move when there is no target).

fields.label: Override
fields.help: Replaces an axis of the target outright.

fields.label: Local frame
fields.help: Run this move in a local frame instead of the active one.

steps.label: Thread Move
steps.description: Move the tool in Z while rotating RZ to follow a thread
steps.syntax: ThreadMove distance=…, pitch=…[, peck=on, peckDepth=…, peckRetract=…][, exitHeight=…][, reverseOut=on]

fields.label: Peck retract
fields.help: Empty = retract fully to the start each peck.

fields.label: Speed
fields.help: Overrides the program's speed for this move only.

steps.label: Run Homing
steps.description: Run the full homing sequence and wait for it to finish

steps.label: Set Joint Position
steps.description: Declare one joint's value with no motion (manual homing)

steps.label: CNC Program
steps.description: Follow a toolpath generated from a DXF or SVG file

fields.label: Toolpath
fields.help: Edited in the CNC builder.

steps.label: Save Position
steps.description: Store the current position in a Points list or a saved point
steps.syntax: SavePosition $<list>[, mode=replace|append|insert|set][, index=…][, source=actual|target] | SavePosition point <name>

fields.label: Saved point
fields.help: Overwritten (or created) with the current position; recorded in the points history.

steps.label: Set Speed (Linear)
steps.description: Set the linear move speed, accel and decel

steps.label: Set Speed (Joint)
steps.description: Set the joint move speed, accel and decel

steps.label: Set Blend Radius
steps.description: Set the default corner radius for later blended moves

steps.label: Set Speed Factor
steps.description: Scale this program's move speeds by a percentage

fields.label: Speed factor
fields.help: Never exceeds the operator's speed override; resets to 100 when the program ends.

steps.label: Set Tool
steps.description: Change the active tool used by later moves

fields.label: Tool
fields.help: None = no tool offset.

steps.label: Set Local
steps.description: Activate a local coordinate frame for later moves

steps.label: Clear Local
steps.description: Return later moves to the world frame

steps.label: If Condition
steps.description: Run steps only when a condition holds, with else-if and else branches

steps.label: Switch
steps.description: Run the case whose value equals an expression

fields.label: Value
fields.help: Evaluated once; compared with each case value.

steps.label: Loop
steps.description: Repeat steps a number of times, for each list element, or while a condition holds
steps.syntax: repeat <n>|forever [as $i] … end | for $v[, $i] in $list … end | while <condition> … end

fields.label: Count
fields.help: 0 = forever.

fields.label: Value variable
fields.help: Number/Boolean lists: the element. Other lists: the index.

steps.label: Break / Next
steps.description: Leave the enclosing loop, or skip to its next iteration

steps.label: Try
steps.description: Run steps; on a runtime error retry them or run the catch steps

fields.label: Catch only

options.label: Arc points are in a line

fields.help: Empty = every catchable error. A Raise Error code may be typed in.

steps.label: Raise Error
steps.description: Fail with a message — caught by an enclosing Try, otherwise ends the program

fields.label: Code
fields.help: An identifier a Try can filter on.

steps.label: Call Routine
steps.description: Run a routine, then continue

fields.label: Arguments
fields.help: One expression per in / in-out parameter (a template for a text parameter), evaluated before the call.

fields.label: Outputs
fields.help: Out / in-out parameters copied into your variables when the routine returns.

steps.label: Return
steps.description: Leave the routine (or end the program)

steps.label: End Program
steps.description: Finish the program now, from anywhere

steps.label: Label
steps.description: Mark a place Go To Label can jump to

steps.label: Go To Label
steps.description: Jump to a Label

steps.label: Pause Program
steps.description: Pause — the operator continues or stops from the monitor

steps.label: Note
steps.description: A note or section header — not executed

steps.label: Set Variable
steps.description: Assign a value or expression to a variable

fields.label: Value
fields.help: An expression; a template for a text variable.

steps.label: List
steps.description: Append, insert, remove, set, sort or copy list elements

fields.label: Value
fields.help: For Number and Boolean lists.

fields.label: Fields
fields.help: For Point and Record lists. Append with no fields on a Points list appends the current position.

fields.label: Sort by field
fields.help: Empty = the element value.

steps.label: Stopwatch
steps.description: Start, stop or reset a stopwatch variable

steps.label: Wait
steps.description: Wait for a time, or until a condition holds
steps.syntax: Wait <ms> | Wait until <condition>[, timeout=…][, timedOut=$v][, onTimeout=continue|error]

fields.label: Timeout
fields.help: Empty or 0 = wait forever.

steps.label: Set Output
steps.description: Turn a digital output on or off, toggle it or pulse it

fields.label: On
fields.help: An expression: non-zero = on.

fields.label: Pulse
fields.help: Set for this long, then flip back. Empty = hold.

steps.label: Tare Load Cell
steps.description: Zero a load cell

steps.label: Read Load Cell
steps.description: Read a load cell into a variable

steps.label: Start Recording
steps.description: Record a load cell into a list variable

steps.label: Stop Recording
steps.description: Stop a recording and store its samples

steps.label: Export Data
steps.description: Write variables to a CSV or JSON file

steps.label: Aux Move
steps.description: Move an aux axis by a distance or a number of steps
steps.syntax: AuxMove device=…, axis=…, distance=…|steps=…[, unit=mm|deg][, velocity=…][, absolute=on][, wait=off][, until=…]

fields.label: Device
fields.help: The aux IO card.

fields.label: Unit
fields.help: Empty = raw steps.

fields.label: Distance
fields.help: In the unit above.

fields.label: Steps
fields.help: Used when no unit is set; the sign is the direction.

fields.label: Stop condition
fields.help: Watched every tick while the move runs, e.g. $io.Nano.Load >= 2000.

fields.label: Position variable
fields.help: Receives the axis position (mm / deg, or steps).

fields.label: Fired flag
fields.help: Set to 1 if the condition fired during the move, else 0.

steps.label: Aux Continuous Run
steps.description: Run an aux axis continuously until an Aux Stop

fields.label: Device
fields.help: The aux IO card.

fields.label: Velocity
fields.help: The sign is the direction.

steps.label: Aux Stop
steps.description: Stop aux axis motion — ramped or immediate

fields.label: Device
fields.help: The aux IO card.

steps.label: Aux Motor Enable
steps.description: Enable or disable the motor drivers of an aux card

fields.label: Device
fields.help: The aux IO card.

steps.label: Gripper
steps.description: Open, close or grip to a jaw gap
steps.syntax: GripperAction open|close|to <mm>[, device=…, axis=…][, velocity=…][, until=…]

fields.label: Device
fields.help: The aux IO card.

fields.label: Stop condition
fields.help: Watched every tick while the move runs, e.g. $io.Nano.Load >= 2000.

fields.label: Position variable
fields.help: Receives the axis position (mm / deg, or steps).

fields.label: Fired flag
fields.help: Set to 1 if the condition fired during the move, else 0.

steps.label: Conveyor
steps.description: Run a conveyor forward or reverse, or stop it

fields.label: Device
fields.help: The aux IO card.

steps.label: Rotary Index
steps.description: Index a rotary axis a number of positions

fields.label: Device
fields.help: The aux IO card.

steps.label: Run Vision
steps.description: Run a vision program and write its results into variables

fields.label: Tool outputs
fields.help: Rows of tool · value → variable.

steps.label: Capture Image
steps.description: Store the current camera frame in an image variable

steps.label: Save Image
steps.description: Save a camera snapshot to a file

steps.label: Start Background
steps.description: Start a background program in parallel

steps.label: Stop Background
steps.description: Stop a background program

steps.label: Wait for Background
steps.description: Wait until a background program finishes

steps.label: HTTP Request
steps.description: POST JSON to a server and read values from the reply
steps.syntax: HttpRequest "<url>"[, wait=on][, timeout=…] send … receive … end

steps.label: HTTP Receive
steps.description: Wait for an HTTP POST to a named webhook

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Other machines POST to /webhook/<name>.

steps.label: Status Update
steps.description: Publish a message, warning or error to the monitor

steps.label: Prompt
steps.description: Ask the operator: show a message with buttons and an optional input
steps.syntax: prompt "<message>"[, title=…][, buttons=(…)][, input=number|text][, result=$v][, value=$v][, timeout=…]

fields.label: Button variable
fields.help: A number variable gets the button index (from 0); a text variable gets its label.

fields.label: Timeout
fields.help: 0 = wait forever.

fields.label: On timeout press
fields.help: Button index chosen on timeout. Empty = fail (catchable).

steps.label: Plugin
steps.description: A step provided by an installed plugin

fields.label: Parameters
fields.help: Typed by the plugin manifest.

fields.label: Timeout
fields.help: Empty = the manifest default; 0 = none.
